CONTROLS.NAME: flashing_mode
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn ON for a brighter flashing effect, instead of the contour lines.

CONTROLS.NAME: triangle_mode
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn ON for shimmering triangles instead of flashing or contour lines.

CONTROLS.NAME: circular_mode
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn ON while other modes are OFF for circular contours instead of angular contours.

CONTROLS.NAME: center_pulse
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: A bright pulse of light that comes out from the center.

CONTROLS.NAME: noise
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Change how noisy the scene is.

CONTROLS.NAME: fragment_media
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Cut the media source into a mosaic of triangles, if a media source is selected.

CONTROLS.NAME: media_pulse
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Zoom out and fly back in on the media, if media is selected.

CONTROLS.NAME: speed
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Speed of the white painting action.

CONTROLS.NAME: EXPLODE
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Rapidly cycle through triangles and hexagons. BOOM.
